text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is seeking authority to prohibit vehicles greater than two metres in width from travelling the public lane, first south of College Street, between Manning Avenue and Clinton Street. Prohibiting vehicles over two metres in width from travelling the subject lane will be beneficial in reducing the incidence of damage to adjacent private property.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited vehicles over two metres in width from travelling the public lane, first south of College Street, between Manning Avenue and Clinton Street.
